children: The software giant's search for relief from a commitment to a server farm has rattled AI lenders. It underscores how construction depends on a few deep-pocketed tech giants. If more waver, expectations of AI labs producing $400 bln of revenue by 2030 will prove too optimistic.
Full view will be published shortly.

Oracle has issued a force majeure notice to a unit of Blue Owl Capital, the developer of the massive New Mexico data-center campus, citing potential delays in securing power for the project, a person familiar with the matter told Reuters on September 24.

The notice indicates that Oracle would try to delay or even back out of the project that has been hit by a number of delays that could prevent the facility from opening on schedule in 2028. Blue Owl, which has invested $3 billion in the project, and borrowed as much as $20 billion from Goldman Sachs and others, says that even if Oracle is able to delay lease payments, the software group would still be responsible to support the project and its financing costs.
Oracle shares fell 3.3% on September 24. They were trading at $138, down 0.8%, on the morning of September 25.
